entities.description: Weatherlight navigator who praises Serra's blessing.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Of the Weatherlight, orders defenders to hold position.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Of the Weatherlight, praises Llanowar's magic.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem haunted by an innocent man's death.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Tyrant of Rath who finds the living useful.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Villain speaking of fading memory, decay and Phyrexian secrets.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: Speaker haunted by memory of a brief action.

entities.name: Autumn Willow
entities.description: Speaker on drought and the baron's foulness.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire baron who believes there is more dark than light.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Lord to whom Lim-Dûl swears servitude.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who improved Thran's ornithopter design.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Artificer who left her mark in the bloodlines of the tortured.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: Journal author who described walls of ice.

entities.name: Grakk
entities.description: Feels warm and fuzzy after pacification.

entities.name: Nethya
entities.description: Person who fell lifeless after Remove Soul.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Leader of the Knights of Stromgald.

entities.name: Maraxus of Keld
entities.description: Keldon speaker threatening to make blood run in sands.

entities.name: Laina
entities.description: Of the Elvish Council, serving Freyalise.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Goddess whose will Fyndhorn elves follow.

entities.name: Bantau

events.summary: Sisay recalls her mother saying angels sing their swords' names with each strike.
events.quote: angels sing their swords' names with each strike.

events.summary: Gerrard says no one can get near the island of Avenant.
events.quote: you can't even get near the island of Avenant.

events.summary: Grakk feels warm and fuzzy for the first time.
events.quote: Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

events.summary: Gerrard calls himself the storm before the calm.
events.quote: Just think of me as the storm before the calm.

events.summary: Hanna says she has seen Serra's strength in angels' wings and sorrow on ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes.
events.quote: I have felt your sorrow rain down on the ruins brought by the Lord of the Wastes.

events.summary: Kaervek tells a victim the memory of their existence will fade.
events.quote: The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning.

events.summary: Ertai recalls Barrin teaching that the hardest lessons are those already learned.
events.quote: the hardest lessons to grasp are the ones you've already learned.

events.summary: Nethya stiffens, cocks her head and falls lifeless.
events.quote: then fell lifeless to the ground.

events.summary: Karn says an innocent man died because of his anger and the knowledge will haunt him.
events.quote: An innocent man died because of my anger.

events.summary: Kaervek says decay is ripening and denies sustenance.
events.quote: You'll gain no sustenance from this harvest.

events.summary: Volrath says he does not hate the living because they are useful, then laughs.
events.quote: I do not hate the living. They often prove quite useful to me.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl declares the Kjeldoran dead will kill those they loved.
events.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl swears himself servant to Leshrac.
events.quote: I am your servant and your slave.

events.summary: Jolrael says one brief action lives forever in memory.
events.quote: It is terrible how one brief action can live forever in memory.

events.summary: The alliance of Balduvia and Kjeldor deprives Stromgald of victories so its agents fuel rituals with their own flesh.
events.quote: its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

events.summary: Avram Garrisson berates trading with elves who burn forests.
events.quote: You don't live in forests, you burn them!

events.summary: Maraxus of Keld threatens to make blood run in the sands.
events.quote: I will make it run in the sands!

events.summary: Squee realizes the forest is thinking of dinner too.
events.quote: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

events.summary: Asmira dreams of a second harvest she fears she will not see.
events.quote: I've dreamt of a second harvest but fear I will not see it.

events.summary: Tawnos solves the puzzle that the structures were Mishra's creations.
events.quote: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle

events.summary: The Brothers' War scarred the land and Ashnod marked bloodlines.
events.quote: Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

events.summary: Urza says he improved the Thran's ornithopter design in his apprenticeship.
events.quote: It has been my honor to improve on the Thran's original design.

events.summary: Mishra says legged engines are born, not made.
events.quote: they were born, not made.
